## Important caveats
- A 1,000-point hit rate is not strategy profitability; the exclusive replay is a simplified model only.
- Retest signals are chosen causally; all original signals without a confirmation are included as skipped.
- Some signal windows overlap; exclusive replay removes overlapping positions within each model.
- No real bid/ask, slippage distribution, funding payments, leverage/liquidation, or portfolio-risk sizing.
- 2025 development-period selection alone cannot establish future performance.
- Signals at the end of December are censored to avoid using any 2026 candle.

## Limitations
- These are modeled BTC price-point results for a 1-BTC-equivalent position, NOT USD account P&L; actual margin, financing and liquidation are not modeled.
- Funding, L1 depth, market impact, live slippage and execution outages excluded.

- Exit month determines monthly realized P&L; forced year-end closure has no January 2026 data.
- Profitability in all 10 months is a goal, not an assumption.

## Interpretation / limits
- Pivot catalogue is hindsight. The causal signal quality is evaluated separately from every eligible hour and BOTH sides.
- No trade is assumed to start at an ex-post pivot; a signal must exist before an outcome window.
- All 2025 is development/previously observed data, including the later-year consistency split.
- Stronger conditional success is not evidence of profitability without exclusive, real entry/exit replay after costs.
- No lookahead into 2026, funding, bid/ask, fills or liquidation modeled.
- Do not promote a condition to a trading strategy unless it beats the baseline and survives an execution backtest.
